{"content":"## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

**Root cause**: The FinalizeGate (gh-1412) keyed on the approval *mode* (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance — so an interactive TUI in autopilot got the full unattended verification contract, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped.

Interactive sessions are gate-free under every approval mode; headless runs carry the contract under any mode.

{"content":"## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

## Summary

**Root cause**: The FinalizeGate (gh-1412) keyed on the approval *mode* (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance — so an interactive TUI in autopilot got the full unattended verification contract, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped.

**Changes**:
- **Attendance, not permission** — `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` now key the gate and the system-prompt contract on `config.headlessRun` (set by the executable for `fa -p`/bench runs). Interactive sessions are gate-free under every approval mode; headless runs carry the contract under any mode.
- **Trivial-turn skip** — new prompt clause in `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (regenerated `prompts.g.dart`), plus loop-level: a run with no tool calls fires no `TaskLedgerEvent` (no produced state ⇒ nothing to verify).
- **Tolerant strip** — `parseTaskLedger` now also catches the unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullet shape (fenced still wins; prose false-positives rejected); new `stripTaskLedger` removes the ledger either way, and the loop rewrites the final answer before `AgentEndEvent` so the transcript never shows it.

**TDD evidence**: RED first (interactive×autopilot prompt test failed, `stripTaskLedger` missing), then GREEN. Updated IT-1 to run headless (the real unattended shape) and IT-2 to pin interactive×autopilot staying ledger-free.

This is the IT harness running the REPL (`cli.run()`), not `runHeadless`. The IT-1 was written when gate keyed on approvalMode. Per the ticket's new semantics, an interactive-REPL harness in autopilot is ATTENDED → gate off. The IT must now run the scenario headlessly: use `runHeadless` instead of `cli.run()` + sendLine.

But wait — IT-2 asserts interactive mode persists NO ledger — that's still valid and now even more meaningful (interactive×autopilot). For IT-1, switch to `cli.runHeadless('Fixture task: ...')` with `headlessRun: true` in the config. The scripted mock drives turns via POSTs; runHeadless drives one prompt. The harness currently: `final run = cli.run();` then delayed sendLine of the fixture prompt, waits for script length, `/exit`. With runHeadless, just `await cli.runHeadless(prompt)` — the mock replays the 5 turns; after the last text turn the run finishes.

One concern: turn 5 is the final answer (text) → run ends. runHeadless settles after. The tool calls (bash) execute for real in tempDir — yes, real env, that's the point of the IT.

{"content":"## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

{"content":"## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

{"content":"## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).

{"content":"## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
